FPT.title: FutPythonTrader data
conditions: provider data available or explicitly unavailable
invariants: point-in-time reads do not use future data
failure_modes: parser drift changes history without version

WEB.title: Read-only web product
conditions: no business authority in the browser
failure_modes: stale data shown without quality state

STA.title: Backtest and statistical validation
conditions: outcomes and sampling rules are defined
invariants: software correctness differs from predictive validity
no profit claim from in-sample data

SEC.title: Offline security and isolation
outputs: authorized read response or controlled denial

requirements.statement: Limit HARD CERTIFIED OFFLINE v1 to the owner-approved included scope.
requirements.behavior: All Gate A/B reports use the approved scope and retain excluded roadmap items as future.

requirements.statement: Do not merge, deploy, write Neon, reactivate Render, acquire LIVE data or incur cost in MP-PR-00.
requirements.behavior: The PR changes governance artifacts and validators only.

requirements.statement: Preserve source hierarchy owner → #3 → #97 → #104 → domain issues → repository documents → mock.
requirements.behavior: Lower sources cannot override higher sources.

requirements.statement: Allow only one operational pull request at a time.
requirements.behavior: PR creation is blocked if another PR is open.

requirements.statement: Stop before merge and require owner approval.
requirements.behavior: PR remains open after CI/review readiness.
conflicts: historical permanent auto-merge permission in #3 is superseded for this PR

requirements.statement: Develop backend/API and certify integrated paths before final UI authority.
requirements.behavior: UI consumes contracts and contains no authoritative business logic.

requirements.statement: Do not declare product complete until data, temporal separation, coverage, reproducibility, responsive UI and secret gates pass.
requirements.behavior: Certification fails when any mandatory P0 remains non-PASS.

requirements.statement: Use PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_VERIFIED and NOT_APPLICABLE without status promotion.
requirements.behavior: Validator rejects unknown states.

requirements.statement: Use standard GitHub-hosted runners with zero additional Actions spend during public development.
requirements.behavior: No larger or paid runner is selected; measured cost remains explicit.

requirements.statement: Keep the frozen provider-trial archive immutable and do not treat it as runtime certification.
requirements.behavior: Archive is read-only evidence; materialization requires MP-PR-01 authorization.
conflicts: issue remains administratively open despite completion evidence

requirements.statement: Treat the historical 82-PR plan as planning history, not the verified Gate A denominator.
requirements.behavior: The atomic inventory is the only v1 denominator after owner acceptance.

requirements.statement: State whether each PR changes visible product behavior and update the mock only when it does.
requirements.behavior: MP-PR-00 declares mock update NO because it changes governance only.

requirements.statement: Discover and preserve every FutPythonTrader field returned upstream.
requirements.behavior: Unknown and future fields enter raw/schema registry without loss.

requirements.statement: Preserve immutable raw snapshots with content hashes and lineage.
requirements.behavior: Derived changes never overwrite original raw bytes.

requirements.statement: Normalize and make queryable every available field, not only fields displayed in UI.
requirements.behavior: Normalized and query layers retain all covered fields.

requirements.statement: Expose coverage N and provenance for each metric and dataset slice.
requirements.behavior: Consumers receive scope, counts, timestamps and source.

requirements.statement: Pin parser/schema/transform/data-contract and identity versions for point-in-time reproduction.
requirements.behavior: The same T and contract version reproduce the same result before and after reprocessing.
conflicts: latest parser output can alter historical query at same T

requirements.statement: Detect gaps, stale checkpoints and interrupted synchronization and recover idempotently.
requirements.behavior: Recovery uses recorded gaps and does not duplicate persisted facts.

requirements.statement: Distinguish AVAILABLE, initial unavailable, regression, provider error, deprecated and removed datasets.
requirements.behavior: Provider unavailability and MatchPilot defects remain distinct.

requirements.statement: Resolve or explicitly classify the 412 historical UNAVAILABLE_404 datasets before global FPT certification.
requirements.behavior: Each dataset has evidence-backed terminal or actionable state.

requirements.statement: Provide pre-match feature slices for form, home/away, goals, xG, shooting, possession, defence, discipline, corners, halves, timing, H2H and odds where available.
requirements.behavior: Unavailable families remain N/D with coverage.

requirements.statement: Require owner promotion for a new league while permitting controlled new-season onboarding.
requirements.behavior: Unapproved leagues cannot enter operational scope.

requirements.statement: Monitor freshness, failures, budget state and schema changes without alert spam.
requirements.behavior: Alerts are fingerprinted, outbound-only and evidence-backed.

requirements.statement: Do not call FutPythonTrader globally certified while residual classification, PIT or real gates remain open.
requirements.behavior: Final verdict is CERTIFIED, CERTIFIED WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS or NOT CERTIFIED only after all gates.
conflicts: historical 20/20 certificate is scoped, not global

requirements.statement: Store lossless TotalCorner raw responses and a request ledger without token leakage.
requirements.behavior: Every attempt is classified and raw-linked when present.

requirements.statement: Use only VERIFIED FPT↔TotalCorner competition mappings in operational collectors.
requirements.behavior: Candidate, ambiguous and unmapped competitions remain excluded with reasons.

requirements.statement: Classify PREMATCH only when provider time is strictly before scheduled kickoff and no in-play minute exists.
requirements.behavior: Late or live rows are INPLAY or QUARANTINE, never PREMATCH.

requirements.statement: Measure provider timezone and fail closed when missing, stale or inconsistent.
requirements.behavior: Prematch capture stops rather than applying an unverified offset.

requirements.statement: Expose opening and last-prematch 1X2, Asian, Goal, Corner, HT and BTTS where upstream provides them.
requirements.behavior: Point-in-time queries respect provider and captured knowledge modes.

requirements.statement: Keep HISTORICAL_UPSTREAM distinct from HISTORICAL_CAPTURED live history.
requirements.behavior: Final-state fields cannot masquerade as minute-by-minute capture.

requirements.statement: Persist live snapshots, events and markets from VERIFIED leagues with canonical deduplication.
requirements.behavior: Unknown payload changes affect identity and identical payloads remain idempotent.

requirements.statement: Recover live cursors after restart and persist provider-confirmed FT exactly once.
requirements.behavior: Restart does not lose terminal state or duplicate snapshot/event rows.

requirements.statement: Share a bounded rate limiter, classify 429/5xx/timeout and apply controlled retry/backoff.
requirements.behavior: Rate-limit failure cannot create an unbounded burst.

requirements.statement: Expose raw linkage, duplicates, gaps, provenance, freshness and leakage counters.
requirements.behavior: Quality problems are visible and machine-readable.

requirements.statement: Route TotalCorner operational alerts through the same outbound-only alert channel as FPT.
requirements.behavior: No inbound Telegram control and no token leakage.

requirements.statement: Do not declare TotalCorner globally certified before prematch, historical, live frequency, restart, FT and replay gates pass.
requirements.behavior: Scoped component evidence cannot promote the full provider.
conflicts: component certifications are not global certification

requirements.statement: Provide a real executable read-only website, not a visual prototype.
requirements.behavior: The browser loads product data from real isolated APIs.

requirements.statement: Show a responsive Daily Board with all available matches and data-quality state.
requirements.behavior: Cards expose teams, competition, kickoff, analytics, markets and coverage when available.

requirements.statement: Provide Match Center search, filters and Home/Away/Both analytical cards.
requirements.behavior: Every available data family is inspectable with provenance and N.

requirements.statement: Provide a finished-match page combining prematch, final state, timeline, markets, replay and post-mortem.
requirements.behavior: Prematch/live/final sections remain visibly and temporally separate.

requirements.statement: Render missing values as N/D rather than numeric zero.
requirements.behavior: Zero is shown only when source semantics prove a real zero.

requirements.statement: Display coverage, source, freshness, gap and quality status for each module.
requirements.behavior: Users can inspect why a value is present, missing or stale.

requirements.statement: Support search and filters for match, date, competition and quality dimensions.
requirements.behavior: Inputs are validated and produce deterministic paginated results.

requirements.statement: Provide charts for historical odds, statistics and replay without implying fabricated continuity.
requirements.behavior: Charts identify observed points, gaps and unavailable series.

requirements.statement: Operate on supported desktop and mobile viewports.
requirements.behavior: Primary flows remain usable and readable at both viewport classes.

requirements.statement: Handle loading, empty, partial and error states explicitly.
requirements.behavior: No silent blank page or stale-success fallback.

requirements.statement: Keep authoritative formulas, strategy, replay and data rules outside the UI.
requirements.behavior: Frontend renders API contracts and cannot change certified outcomes.

requirements.statement: Expose replay controls and synchronized state in the real site.
requirements.behavior: Play, pause, stop, step, seek and speed controls drive the certified replay clock.

requirements.statement: Select a finished match and reconstruct its chronological state from authentic captured data.
requirements.behavior: Replay consumes verified archive records, not generated demo data.

requirements.statement: Return the same state for match, timestamp, dataset, code, config and seed.
requirements.behavior: Every run emits a reproducibility manifest.

requirements.statement: Prevent algorithms from reading any information later than simulated time.
requirements.behavior: All source reads apply provider_time and observed_at knowledge cutoffs.

requirements.statement: Support configurable speed, pause, resume and event-by-event stepping.
requirements.behavior: Clock transitions are deterministic and testable.

requirements.statement: Support seek and jumps to kickoff, HT, 60, 75, 90, FT and available events.
requirements.behavior: Jump targets correspond to real timestamps and cannot reveal later state.

requirements.statement: Expose score, status, statistics, markets and last event available at each replay instant.
requirements.behavior: Each value carries provenance and quality.

requirements.statement: Never invent intermediate snapshots or interpolate unauthorized information.
requirements.behavior: Only observed or explicitly last-known values are emitted with labels.

requirements.statement: Identify missing snapshots, gaps, late data and incomplete matches.
requirements.behavior: Timeline shows gap duration and last valid snapshot without claiming continuity.

requirements.statement: Handle out-of-order timestamps, duplicates, corrections and simultaneous events deterministically.
requirements.behavior: Ordering and correction rules are explicit and stable.

requirements.statement: Restart a replay without changing state or duplicating predictions/events.
requirements.behavior: Persisted checkpoint resumes exactly once.

requirements.statement: Expose replay through a versioned read-only API with validated match/time inputs.
requirements.behavior: Invalid or unavailable ranges return explicit contract errors.

requirements.statement: Certify replay on complete, incomplete, multi-goal, market-movement and event-rich authentic matches.
requirements.behavior: Raw-to-replay comparison passes with documented limitations.

requirements.statement: Version every strategy, rule set and parameter set immutably.
requirements.behavior: Backtest result references the exact strategy version.

requirements.statement: Verify mathematical formulas independently from data and predictive performance.
requirements.behavior: Oracle vectors and property tests validate calculations.

requirements.statement: Verify authenticity, temporal validity, provenance and coherence of backtest inputs.
requirements.behavior: Runs fail on unknown dataset hash or invalid timestamps.

requirements.statement: Evaluate predictive validity strictly outside training/selection data.
requirements.behavior: In-sample metrics cannot satisfy the predictive gate.

requirements.statement: Run chronological backtests with no look-ahead leakage.
requirements.behavior: Decisions at T consume only the replay state at T.

requirements.statement: Support walk-forward validation with frozen train, validation and test windows.
requirements.behavior: Window definitions are stored in the run manifest.

requirements.statement: Calculate Brier score, log loss and calibration where probabilistic forecasts exist.
requirements.behavior: Undefined metrics for insufficient data are reported, not coerced to zero.

requirements.statement: Report ROI, strike rate, drawdown and sample size with consistent definitions.
requirements.behavior: Metric formulas and units are versioned.

requirements.statement: Report confidence intervals or justified uncertainty estimates.
requirements.behavior: Small samples are flagged and cannot support reliability claims.

requirements.statement: Compare predictive models with simple documented baselines.
requirements.behavior: Improvement is reported with uncertainty and identical test windows.

requirements.statement: Treat NO TRADE as a valid reproducible strategy outcome.
requirements.behavior: Failed evidence, edge or quality gates emit NO TRADE with reasons.

requirements.statement: Prohibit profitable/reliable claims based on few matches or in-sample results.
requirements.behavior: Certification report separates technical correctness from predictive validity.

requirements.statement: Execute unit tests against production functions with meaningful assertions.
requirements.behavior: Test existence without behavioral assertion is rejected.

requirements.statement: Run integration tests against isolated real PostgreSQL and real backend code.
requirements.behavior: Migrations and HTTP process execute in CI without provider calls.

requirements.statement: Validate versioned API schemas, inputs, errors and compatibility.
requirements.behavior: Breaking changes fail contract tests.

requirements.statement: Run frontend and browser E2E tests on the real web application.
requirements.behavior: Playwright records failures, traces and scoped screenshots.

requirements.statement: Run dependency, secret, authorization and unsafe-configuration tests.
requirements.behavior: HIGH/CRITICAL findings block promotion.

requirements.statement: Test crash, restart, concurrent requests and idempotent recovery.
requirements.behavior: No duplicate event, replay prediction or database mutation occurs.

requirements.statement: Measure API, database and replay performance against explicit budgets.
requirements.behavior: Reports include dataset size, hardware and percentile latency.

requirements.statement: For every defect, preserve RED evidence, apply the minimal fix, obtain GREEN and run pertinent regression.
requirements.behavior: Changing expectations to accept wrong behavior is forbidden.

requirements.statement: Maintain a stable required CI gate that fails closed on unknown or failed selected lanes.
requirements.behavior: Classifier errors select full suite and cannot leave required checks pending.

requirements.statement: Record commit, environment, dependencies, dataset hash, command, result, log, artifact, time and limitations for certifications.
requirements.behavior: Missing mandatory evidence yields NOT_VERIFIED.

requirements.statement: Separate implementer, reviewer and certifier roles where possible.
requirements.behavior: Review records identity, commit, findings, severity, correction and re-review.

requirements.statement: Link every new PR to requirements and risk-sized mandatory tests.
requirements.behavior: Nonconforming changes cannot be promoted through configured GitHub checks.

requirements.statement: Protect the real read-only website and API with server-side authentication/authorization appropriate to offline v1.
requirements.behavior: Direct URL or API access without authority is denied.
conflicts: full SaaS user foundation is future, but owner/admin security baseline is phase 0

requirements.statement: Keep credentials out of repository, docs, fixtures, logs, errors and endpoints.
requirements.behavior: Only environment/config references are permitted and values are never emitted.

requirements.statement: Never provide production Neon credentials or provider secrets to ordinary PR test jobs.
requirements.behavior: CI uses local PostgreSQL and sanitized fixtures.

requirements.statement: Use least-privilege workflow permissions and immutable action pins.
requirements.behavior: Untrusted code cannot write repository contents or access secrets.

requirements.statement: Reject non-local DATABASE_URL in offline and test modes before connection or migration.
requirements.behavior: Unsafe startup exits fail closed.

requirements.statement: Validate and bind all API inputs; prohibit query injection and unbounded resource requests.
requirements.behavior: Invalid input returns explicit 4xx without executing unsafe query.

requirements.statement: Protect sessions against fixation, CSRF, brute force and stale/revoked access.
requirements.behavior: Logout and revocation invalidate access server-side.

requirements.statement: Fail safely on corrupt input, unavailable DB, timeout, crash, malformed API, bad manifest and insufficient resources.
requirements.behavior: Expected error is observable and does not corrupt persistent state.

requirements.statement: Audit dependencies and record unresolved vulnerabilities without hiding unavailable alert state.
requirements.behavior: High-severity dependency findings fail CI or receive an approved exception.
conflicts: Dependabot/code/secret scanning API state not available in pre-flight

requirements.statement: Verify manifest and SHA before reading an archive and never modify original archive bytes.
requirements.behavior: Mismatch blocks replay and backtest.

requirements.statement: Apply advanced API/feed protection only after core security and integrated certification.
requirements.behavior: Hardening cannot substitute for authentication, authorization or tests.

requirements.statement: Leave no open HIGH/CRITICAL security finding attributable to MatchPilot in offline v1.
requirements.behavior: Any such finding blocks HARD CERTIFIED OFFLINE.
